post.description: Perform a batch upsert of auto-association settings in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to update or insert multiple auto-association customizations at once, streamlining the process of managing these settings. The request body must include an array of association customizations to upsert.

get.description: Retrieve the auto-association settings for a specific object type in HubSpot. This endpoint allows you to view the current selection and available options for automatic associations related to the specified object type.

parameters.name: subjectObjectType
parameters.description: The type of object for which to retrieve auto-association settings. This parameter identifies the specific subject object type in HubSpot.

get.description: Retrieve the default auto-association behaviors for a specified object type in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to understand the default settings applied to automatic associations, which can help in managing and configuring CRM associations effectively.

parameters.description: The type of object for which to retrieve default auto-association behaviors. This parameter identifies the specific CRM object type, such as contacts or deals.
